name: Parent Notification of Controlled Substance Incident
description: Parents of students directly involved in a controlled substance incident are notified and told whether law enforcement has been or may be notified; attempts to reach them are documented.
recipient: Parents / guardians of students directly involved
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall notify the parent/guardian of any student directly involved in an incident involving use of controlled substances immediately, as soon as practicable. The Superintendent or designee shall inform the parent/guardian whether or not the law enforcement agency that has jurisdiction over the school property has been or may be notified of the incident.
